districts.name: Belize
districts.insight: Belize has the largest population and the highest district density.

districts.name: Cayo
districts.insight: Cayo has the second-largest population, but its larger land area gives it a lower density than Corozal and Stann Creek.

districts.name: Corozal
districts.insight: Corozal has fewer people than Cayo, yet more people per square kilometre because its area is much smaller.

districts.name: Orange Walk
districts.insight: Orange Walk has more people than Stann Creek, but a lower density because it covers more than twice as much land.

districts.name: Stann Creek
districts.insight: Stann Creek has a smaller population than Orange Walk, but a higher density.

districts.name: Toledo
districts.insight: Toledo has the lowest average density. A district average does not mean every village has the same settlement pattern.
